Closes #2639

Long integration modules currently recheck cohort currentness only between module builds, so a superseded cohort can hold the scarce Windows build lane for several minutes. This adds an optional cancellation probe to the existing Invoke-P3Build polling loop; ordinary builds remain unchanged when no probe is supplied.

The cohort workspace route supplies a 30s selection-current probe. A superseded selection terminates only the wrapper-owned UBT process tree, exits with a distinct 125 result, and releases rather than caches the validation single-flight entry. Probe errors fail open; existing between-module and post-build currentness checks remain authoritative.

body:
Automates the existing fail-closed PR merge guard instead of requiring a human/agent to watch gates and invoke merge manually.

Behavior:
- trusted-main workflow only; never checks out candidate PR source
- wakes from `p3 PR contract gate`, `p3 C++ integration cohort`, and `V2 architecture ratchet`
- delegates readiness to existing `Invoke-P3PrMergeGuard.ps1`
- exact current-base cohort success remains mandatory for C++ PRs
- V2-ratchet paths explicitly require successful `V2 architecture ratchet`
- ratchet/cohort wake-ups scan only PR numbers and remain trigger-scoped; exact guard decides eligibility
- ratchet scan handles `pull_request_target` runs whose `workflow_run.pull_requests` array is empty
- exact BusyCoordinator claims protect both `refs/heads/main` and the target PR mutation
- guard rechecks live head + live main immediately before merge and uses `--match-head-commit`
- serialized landing; at most one PR per workflow run
- after a merge, explicitly dispatches the cohort so remaining C++ heads validate against the new main
- no GitHub native `--auto`

Validation on the combined head:
- `Test-P3PrMergeGuard.ps1`: PASS
- `.github/Test-P3PrGateRouting.ps1`: PASS
- Busy collision semantics: contested claim returns `{ok:false}` with exit 0, so normal contention defers cleanly
- `git diff --check`: PASS

This PR itself needs one guarded bootstrap landing. After that, eligible source/CI PR landing is event-driven.
title: CI: auto-merge exact ready PRs
